text:
leo (infra): scheduling coordinated tf apply for vpn+iam across ap-southeast-1 and us-east-1 on 2025-02-10T03:00Z. plan is micro-canary in ap-southeast-1, then staggered waves. provider pin + checksum verified.

anya (platform): please pin providers in root: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.90" } }`. add `provider_lock = true` to release config.

sam (sre): safety rules for deploybot: abort if control-plane 5xx >3% for 5m OR route flaps >8% in a wave. also require `--dry-run` on canary.

carla (release): i'll draft release notes and include rollback contacts and runbook links. putting draft at https://confluence.example.com/display/release/2025-02-10-infra

leo (infra): rollback criteria: any new IAM denies to critical services OR control-plane errors -> immediate rollback. rollback owner = sam until infra-oncall picks up. rollback runbook: https://runbook.example.com/tf-rollback-2025

deploybot: [scheduled] deploybot queued: micro-canary ap-southeast-1 at 3321004321. owner: leo. notify channels: #eng-oncall #security.

anya (platform): canary commands:
```
terraform plan -target=module.vpn -var='region=ap-southeast-1' -out=canary.plan
terraform apply -auto-approve canary.plan
```
Use `-parallelism=6` and timeout 10m per module.

sam (sre): pause between waves 12m. checklist: 1) deploybot reports success, 2) health endpoints OK, 3) no 5xx spike, 4) IAM smoke tests pass. I will run automated IAM asserts.

leo (infra): if canary passes i'll kick wave2. if anything fails: `deploybot cancel --id $JOB` then `terraform state restore -from=tag/2025-02-03` and run `terraform apply previous.plan`. Escape hatch: manual provider-pin + restore tfstate.

carla (release): release note saved: "vpn + IAM batched apply; micro-canary ap-southeast-1; rollback on 5xx or IAM denies; pause 12m between waves." paging list: @sre-oncall, @infra-oncall.

anya (platform): rotate ephemeral deploy SA keys after each successful wave: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create --iam-account=deploy-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com key.json` then `vault kv put secret/deploy/sa-key @key.json ttl=3600`.

runbook-bot: Runbook link validated: https://runbook.example.com/tf-rollback-2025 (ok).

leo (infra): will post `deploybot start` at T-5. thanks team :thumbsup:

sam (sre): standing by for smoke tests and will escalate on any IAM denies. :raised_hands:
